$schema_note: Static behaviour record. No code is executed by this file.
authn_before_authz: APIKeyAuthentication runs before any permission class: missing credentials -> 401 (DRF NotAuthenticated default); an INVALID token -> 403 {'detail': 'Given API token is not valid'} (pinned by contract test_me_bad_token_403). Anonymous callers therefore 401 on every D-19 route, never reach the permission matrix below. Slug-or-UUID project kwargs are rewritten to UUIDs before check_permissions (views/base.py:52-104), except for anonymous callers.
deny_body: DRF default PermissionDenied: 403 {'detail': 'You do not have permission to perform this action.'} (framework default via exception_handler; contract suites assert the status).

representative_routes: POST/PATCH/DELETE members/ and project-members/ aliases (via get_permissions, views/member.py:98-101)
ProjectAdminPermission.rule: Active ProjectMember row with role=20 on view.project_id, any method (permissions/project.py:119-130). Project MEMBER (15) and GUEST (5) rows deny; workspace ADMIN without a project-ADMIN row denies.

ProjectBasePermission.rule: SAFE: any active WorkspaceMember row in the slug (any role incl. GUEST=5). POST: ws role in (20,15), active. Other methods: active project row with role=20, OR (any active project row AND active ws role=20) (permissions/project.py:13-55).

verdicts.project_member_ws_member: GET allow; POST allow (ws 15); PATCH deny 403 (not admin, not ws-admin)
verdicts.ws_admin_no_project_row: GET allow; POST allow; PATCH deny 403 (override needs a project row)
verdicts.ws_guest_no_project_row: GET allow; POST deny; PATCH deny

ProjectEntityPermission.note: Registered on the estimate endpoints, but the estimate URL patterns are NOT included in urls/__init__.py so every estimate route 404s before permissions run (ported bug; see handlers/workflow.golden.json). Matrix below is the class behaviour for the port.
ProjectEntityPermission.rule: SAFE with view.project_identifier set: active member of that identifier's project. SAFE: active member of view.project_id. Else: active project row with role in (20,15) (permissions/project.py:85-116). Project GUEST denies writes.

ProjectMemberPermission.rule: SAFE: ANY active ProjectMember row in the workspace — NOT project-scoped (no project_id filter, permissions/project.py:62-65). POST: ws role in (20,15), active. Tail branch (non-safe, non-POST: project role in (20,15)) is unreachable from D-19 routes because get_permissions swaps PATCH/DELETE to ProjectAdminPermission (views/member.py:98-101) — port it anyway.

verdicts.ws_member_other_project_row: GET allow (workspace-scoped check — cross-project read allowed)

ProjectStateEntityPermission.rule: SAFE: any active ProjectMember row on view.project_id. Writes: can_mutate_states — project ADMIN always; project MEMBER iff project.members_can_edit_states; otherwise ws ADMIN **who is also an active project member (any role incl. GUEST)**. A ws ADMIN with NO project row denies (membership None -> False). A project GUEST who is not a ws admin denies (permissions/project.py:146-206).

verdicts.ws_admin_no_project_row: GET deny 403 (no membership row); POST deny 403

WorkSpaceAdminPermission.rule: Active WorkspaceMember row with role in (20,15) — GUEST=5 denies (permissions/workspace.py:61-70). project.py views import this name from pi_dash.app.permissions; member.py imports it from pi_dash.utils.permissions — byte-identical copies (diff empty).

WorkspaceOwnerPermission.rule: WorkspaceMember row with role == 20 (Admin) — NO is_active filter, so an INACTIVE workspace admin still passes (quirk, permissions/workspace.py:51-60). Workspace MEMBER (15) denies everything incl. GET (pinned by contract test_denied_member). member.py invite view imports it from pi_dash.utils.permissions (identical copy).

name_resolution.note: pi_dash/utils/permissions/ is a near-duplicate of pi_dash/app/permissions/: project.py copies are identical EXCEPT the utils copy lacks can_mutate_states + ProjectStateEntityPermission (app-only, 63 lines); workspace.py copies are byte-identical; base.py copies differ in one allow_permission branch (workspace-membership pre-check, app-only) which no D-19 view uses.
name_resolution.state_estimate_views: ProjectStateEntityPermission from pi_dash.app.permissions (views/state.py:15); ProjectEntityPermission from pi_dash.app.permissions.project (views/estimate.py:11)

roles: ADMIN=20, MEMBER=15, GUEST=5 (ROLE enum: app/permissions/base.py:13-16, utils/permissions/base.py, models/project.py:28-31). 'owner' below = workspace ADMIN (creator); there is no separate owner role value.
